dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.text: What do you study at university?
dialogue.en: What subject do you learn at the university?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I study linguistics. I want a master's degree next year.

glosses.meaning: a title you get after finishing university

dialogue.en: I learn about language. I want a higher title next year.

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.text: Nice! Do you have any assignments this week?
dialogue.en: Good! Do you have homework this week?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, a research paper. The deadline is Friday.

glosses.meaning: careful study to find new facts
the last day to finish something

dialogue.en: Yes, a long paper. The last day is Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.text: Did you ask your professor for help?
dialogue.en: Did you ask your teacher to help?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I did. I will graduate in May, so I must work hard.

glosses.meaning: to finish your studies at a school

dialogue.en: Yes. I finish school in May, so I must try hard.

practice_words.tip: Say REE-search: stress the first part
Say di-GREE: stress the second part
